name: B10-0490/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified oilseed rape MON 88302, pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the licence for a genetically modified oilseed rape, called MON 88302. The Parliament says the crop can spread in the wild, is tolerant to a weedkiller linked to harm to nature and health, and that the safety checks did not look at long-term effects. The Parliament also wants the Commission to propose new rules for deciding on genetically modified crops, because Member States often fail to agree.

- The Parliament asks the Commission to drop the renewal and not approve the crop.
- It affects farmers, food and feed businesses, and the environment across the European Union.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to withdraw its plan or keep it; Parliament also wants new rules on how such approvals are decided.
